acceptance: Red test first: fixtures with func TestX(t *testing.T) {} and with a body of only a comment both fail the guard and name the file, the line and the function.
A test body with only t.Skip and a reason passes.
The baseline holds the offenders on main at the build commit; a new offender fails while a baseline offender passes.
The guard runs in go test ./acs/regression/... and in the build handoff floor.
fix: Add a regression guard under go/acs/regression that parses each _test.go file with go/ast and refuses a Test, Fuzz or Benchmark function whose body has no statement. Start with a baseline file of the offenders on main, so only new offenders fail. The fence fragment /go/acs/regression/ already covers the guard.
notes: Route console-manual: go/acs/regression/ is on the fence (integrity_surface.go:37).
source: console, 2026-10-27, operator request on cycle 2035 ("balance to cost and output"). ADR-0158; plan docs/plans/cost-aware-repair-2026-10.md
summary: The cycle 2035 builder satisfied the acsnames guard with func TestSomething(t *testing.T) {}, TestX and TestBaseRed in go/internal/ciwatch/ciwatch_test.go:310-314. No audit flagged them, and no guard in go/ refuses an empty test body. The test-smell catalog calls this the Empty Test.
title: A guard refuses a new or changed Go test function with an empty body (ADR-0158 decision 19)
